universe_rule: Candidates are USDT-M perps with archive history from 2020-01 (verified HTTP 200 on data.binance.vision). Each asset is walked month-by-month from 2020-01; the first missing/blocked/partial month ends that asset's contiguous window (recorded with a reason).  Assets failing 2020-01 are excluded entirely. 5m klines are truncated to the accepted window and resampled to 1h OHLCV on the asset's own 1h UTC grid; funding calc_time is floored to its native Binance funding boundary (8h/4h; recorded per asset) and placed on the 1h grid at boundary hours only. The spot leg is real spot 1h klines from data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/klines over each asset's window; spot gaps are NOT imputed: recorded per asset, and the runner's fail-closed gates block any trade needing missing spot data. Requires >= 2880 contiguous 1h bars (one WF train+test). No impute/ffill/resample of derived series.
